**Asia pre-market reactions — 2026-09-30 (Wed)**

**TL;DR**

- Broad rebound day across Asia: **Nikkei +1.94%**, **TWSE +0.65%**, **HSI +0.37%**, **KOSPI -0.48%** (Korea the laggard again).
- Theme: **"Tech Surge Leads Asian Stock Markets Higher"** — Micron's earnings beat the night before carried into Asia's chip / display / semi-cap names.
- Biggest single-name moves: **Meiko Electronics 6787.T +7.99%** (PCB name, broad electronics bid); **AUO 2409.TW +9.99%** + **Innolux 3481.TW +9.95%** (display-panel rebound on Micron-driven AI-demand read);
- **SKC 011790.KS +7.93%** (semicon materials rebound); **Convano 6574.T +7.50%**, **Sumitomo Electric 5802.T +6.65%**, **SoftBank 9984.T +6.54%** on **Sterlington advises DigitalBridge Management Team on acquisition by SoftBank Group**.
- Mean-reversion day 2: Nidec +4.67% (vs Mon -17.61%, Tue -3.85%), Hanwha Solutions +4.31% (vs Mon +14.21%, Tue -2.55%), SKC +7.93% (vs Tue -2.46%).
- Notable counter-trend: **Sunac 1918.HK -5.07%** (reversal of Mon-Tue's property-rebound bid);
- **financials sold in KR** (Shinhan -3.98%, Hana -3.92%, KB -2.71%, DB Insurance -3.44%, Samsung Life -2.93%, Samsung F&M -3.06%) even as they rallied in JP.
- Catalyst-rich names: **Z.AI 2513.HK +4.31%** on **$5B shares + convertible bond raise** (China AI fundraising); **Fujikura 5803.T +5.94%** on **Commonwealth Fusion Systems' largest HTS-tape purchase order** (fusion);
- **Hanwha Solutions 009830.KS** continues to make news on **Q2 earnings + US solar-import detention story**.
